title: Three-Project Solution Scaffold + IKeychainProvider
keyDecisionsMade: Used OperatingSystem.IsMacOS()/IsWindows()/IsLinux() instead of RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() in KeychainProviderFactory.Create() and EncryptedFileKeychainProvider — the Roslyn CA1416 analyzer only recognises OperatingSystem.IsXxx() as valid platform guards, not RuntimeInformation.
Added [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes to the TryCreateMacOs, TryCreateWindows, TryCreateLinux, and GetWindowsMachineGuid helper methods to satisfy CA1416 with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true.
Created DependencyInjectionRegistrar.cs in CliqCli project to bridge Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection with Spectre.Console.Cli's ITypeRegistrar — required for DI to work with the command app.
Used dotnet new sln --format sln to create the .sln file (not .slnx) as .NET 10 defaults to .slnx but the story specifies .sln.
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider key derivation: SHA-256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'cliq-cli') per OQ-002 default.
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider file layout: [12-byte IV][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag], stored at <configDir>/keystore/<sanitized-key>.bin where ':' is replaced with '_'.
LinuxKeychainProvider uses TryCreate() factory pattern — catches DllNotFoundException on libsecret-1.so.0 load failure, performs a sentinel probe lookup on init, returns false to activate fallback.
CliqCli.Core.csproj references Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection 10.0.0 — packages at version 10 are available with .NET 10 SDK 10.0.105.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Followed default assumption: SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'cliq-cli'). MachineGuid obtained via ioreg on macOS, Windows Registry on Windows, /etc/machine-id on Linux. IV stored as first 12 bytes of .bin file, ciphertext + 16-byte tag follow.

Followed default assumption: libsecret-1 via P/Invoke with fixed 2-attribute schema (application=cliq-cli, key=<keystring>). TryCreate() catches DllNotFoundException and init probe errors; returns false to trigger EncryptedFileKeychainProvider fallback. CallingConvention.Cdecl used for variadic P/Invoke signatures.

issuesEncountered.issue: CA1416 platform compatibility errors with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true: RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() is not recognised as a platform guard by the Roslyn analyzer.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Replaced all RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() calls with OperatingSystem.IsMacOS(), OperatingSystem.IsWindows(), OperatingSystem.IsLinux(). Added [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes to the platform-specific helper methods.

issuesEncountered.issue: dotnet new sln in .NET 10 creates .slnx by default, not .sln.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Used dotnet new sln --format sln flag to force the legacy .sln format as specified in the story.

issuesEncountered.issue: Unused using directives (System.Runtime.InteropServices, System.Text.Json) in EncryptedFileKeychainProvider would cause warnings with TreatWarningsAsErrors.
